name: Naughtyness
description: If checked, you're guaranteed a spot on Santa's naughty list

name: V-Slice Accuracy Style
description:
If checked, the accuracy system used in V-Slice will apply to the results screen.
(Sicks and Goods = 100% accuracy)

name: Total Excludes Misses
description: If checked, the "TOTAL NOTES" section of the menu will not include notes you missed. This is true in base game.

name: Results Character:
description: Decides which character will be shown in the results screen. When Adaptive is selected, it will play the matching characters results screens. (Not BF or Pico = random)

name: Theme Color:
description: Changes the color of the results screen. To use custom RGB values, Custom must be selected. Adaptive bases the color of the screen off of your rank.

name: Theme Red:
description: Sets the red RGB value for the results screen. (MUST HAVE THEME COLOR SET TO CUSTOM)

name: Theme Green:
description: Sets the green RGB value for the results screen. (MUST HAVE THEME COLOR SET TO CUSTOM)

name: Theme Blue:
description: Sets the blue RGB value for the results screen. (MUST HAVE THEME COLOR SET TO CUSTOM)

name: Mobile Exit:
description: Helps mobile players be able to exit the results screen, if you are on PC, use the 'PC' Option
